recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-18470 source change is recommended unless a separate editorial review revises the surrounding RDF guidance for unrelated reasons.
issue_request: FHIR-18470 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for the FHIR-core RDF page asking that the phrase "not required nor expected" be changed to "not required or expected".
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit was found, but commit 7bf7397f4a965784698e0d343f8a96789cdf4942 changed the exact RDF bullet from "not required nor expected" to "not required or expected" shortly after the issue was raised.
additional_context: The RDF page was later substantially rewritten by commit 0eb9b5726183fb5fbd1d4fc999aee901f444f44a, and that rewrite preserved the corrected wording as "not required or expected in conforming FHIR Turtle." The page remains in current build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active source/rdf.html already contains the requested corrected wording.
